# rawmktg

> rawmktg is a blog by Epic Slope Partners covering B2B marketing strategy, SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), AI search visibility, and content marketing for SaaS companies.

## Published Posts

- [The Anatomy of a High-Citation Page](/posts/anatomy-of-a-high-citation-page.html): What makes a page get cited by AI systems — structure, signals, and the elements that build trust with LLMs.
- [Authority Seeding for AI & LLM Trust](/posts/authority-seeding-ai-llm-trust.html): How to build AI-readable authority signals so your brand gets cited, not ignored, by generative search engines.
- [The 30-Day Content Half-Life](/posts/30-day-content-half-life-recency-ai-ranking-signal.html): Why recency is now a ranking signal in AI-powered search and how to keep content fresh enough to matter.
